title: RGB blocks
description: Massive RGB building block palette for NeoForge.
body:
# RGBBlocks

RGBBlocks is a structured RGB building palette mod for Minecraft NeoForge.

The mod adds over 16,600 carefully generated building colors with a focus on smooth gradients, pastel tones, neutral materials, and architectural usability.

Each color includes three block variants:

* Normal
* Glow
* Glass

RGBBlocks keeps its color palette as static full blocks rather than dynamically colored block entities. A separate RGB lighting layer provides colored illumination while preserving compatibility, stability, shader behavior, and mod interaction.

## Features

![3mod showcase](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/380dd67eea84782b016877903d7eb1196ab93ab2.jpeg)
![pallete](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/08d6b3dd284fcc4de25d3754e11a79f504cea762.jpeg)
![lgb light showcase](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/6b6ff66f65efb405b3e5d2476c62c90d770a7084.jpeg)
* Over 16,600 structured building colors
* Pastel and neutral optimized palette generation
* Smooth gradient-focused color organization
* Normal, Glow, and Glass variants
* Subtle RGB colored lighting(Glow variant)
* Lightweight static block architecture
* Designed for high compatibility
* Chisels & Bits friendly

## RGB Lighting Modes

RGBBlocks supports two RGB lighting update modes:

MANUAL Mode is intended for large or lighting-intensive builds, reducing continuous RGB lighting recalculation during construction and allowing creators to apply accumulated changes at a chosen time.

- **AUTO Mode** updates RGB lighting automatically when RGB Glow blocks or Chisels & Bits Glow bits are placed, changed, or removed.
- **MANUAL Mode** records changed RGB light source positions without immediately rebuilding the RGB light field. Lighting is updated when a Bake is executed.
- The default mode is **AUTO**.
- The default Bake radius is **32 blocks**.
- Bake radius can be configured from **4 to 256 blocks** around the player.
- **ALL** Bake processes every recorded dirty position in the current dimension. It does not scan every block in the world.
- Changes made while a Bake is already running remain pending for the next Bake instead of extending the current operation.
- Dirty positions in unloaded chunks remain recorded and can be processed after those chunks are loaded.

### Commands

Commands require operator or gamemaster permission.

- `/rgb auto` - Enables automatic RGB lighting updates.
- `/rgb manual` - Enables manual RGB lighting updates.
- `/rgb bake` - Bakes RGB lighting using the currently selected scope.
- `/rgb setbake <4-256>` - Sets a player-centered Bake radius.
- `/rgb setbake all` - Selects all recorded dirty positions in the current dimension.
- `/rgb get` - Displays the current RGB mode, Bake scope, and world ID.
- `/rgb bake get` - Displays the same RGB runtime status.

### RGB Tools

A new **RGB Tools** creative tab contains:

- **RGB Light Switch** - Right-click to toggle between AUTO and MANUAL modes.
- **RGB Light Baker** - Right-click to execute a Bake using the currently selected scope.

### Lighting Persistence

The selected RGB mode and Bake scope are saved with the world and synchronized to connected players.

RGB light sections, full-block RGB source positions, Chisels & Bits RGB source data, and unbaked dirty positions are stored per world and dimension on the client. This allows baked RGB lighting and pending Manual changes to survive chunk unloading, reconnecting, and server restarts.

## Compatibility

RGBBlocks is designed around standard full-block behavior to maximize compatibility with shaders, building tools, and other mods.

The mod has been tested in both singleplayer and multiplayer environments.

## Recommended Usage

RGBBlocks works especially well for:

* Architectural builds
* Gradient detailing
* Modern and pastel builds
* Chisels & Bits creations
* Pixel art
* Builds requiring precise color expression

## Tested Environment

RGBBlocks has been tested with the following environment:

* Minecraft NeoForge 26.1.2.41-beta
* Chisels & Bits neoforge-26.1.2.33(Recommended)
* Iris NeoForge 1.10.9
* Sodium NeoForge 0.8.11
* Complementary Shaders
* Singleplayer and Multiplayer environments

The mod is designed around standard static full-block behavior for broad compatibility with shaders, building tools, and other mods.

## Design Philosophy

RGBBlocks focuses on stability, simplicity, and large-scale color availability. The palette remains based on predictable static full blocks, while RGB illumination is handled by a separate lighting layer with both automatic and manual-bake workflows.

The mod intentionally avoids dynamically colored block entities and per-block custom color rendering. This preserves broad compatibility with shaders, building tools, Chisels & Bits, and the Minecraft modding ecosystem.

Built for Minecraft NeoForge.

## Known Issue

-If a “Lost Connection” error occurs after updating RGB blocks while using Chisels & Bits, delete the clipboard .dat files inside:

.minecraft/chiselsandbits
